predictor: mu(x)=0 fixed before all calibration/test data; no fitted model or tuning
estimand: Marginal target coverage P(Y in C(X)), averaging over independent calibration sets and new target draws; not conditional or universal coverage.
assumptions: target draws iid and independent of calibration
known positive oracle target/source covariate ratio

methods.vanilla: absolute residual scores |Y|; quantile rank ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)); infinity when rank>n
methods.oracle_weighted: weights w(x)=target_p/0.1 if x=1 else (1-target_p)/0.9; weighted (1-alpha) quantile of calibration scores plus test-point weight at +infinity
methods.wrong_ratio: deliberate misspecification: reciprocal of oracle weights, same infinity correction

seed_rule: SHA256 of UTF-8 string master_seed:replication:stream, interpreted as big-endian integer; stream calibration or scenario name; Python random.Random
pairing: Within replication use same source calibration and each scenario test sample for all methods. Independent replication seeds; no validation/tuning data used.
uncertainty: Replicate-level mean +/- 1.9842169515086827 * sample_SD/sqrt(100), approximate pointwise 95% t intervals. Never treat all shared-calibration predictions as independent Bernoulli trials. Paired gaps use replicate differences.
outputs: mean width/CI and infinite interval rate
point prediction bias, variance, RMSE diagnostics
positive negative boundary and tamper logs

acceptance.controls: All deterministic quantile/weights/invalid-input controls pass; deleting test-point infinity atom must fail its fixed boundary fixture; tampering one logged coverage count must be rejected.
acceptance.no_shift: vanilla coverage mean in [0.87,0.93]; weighted and vanilla exactly equal on all per-replication predictions
acceptance.covariate_high_repair: oracle weighted CI lower > 0.87, CI upper < 0.95, mean interval width < 16, infinite-interval rate = 0 in this finite planned sample
acceptance.conditional_limit: oracle weighted coverage CI upper < 0.80 for conditional_scale and < 0.50 for location_shift
acceptance.failure_policy: Retain any failed criterion, do not change parameters, seed or thresholds; report baseline incomplete if applicable.

budget.trial_definition: one independent calibration replicate with five frozen target scenarios (500 scenario-replicates total); deterministic unit tests are not stochastic search trials
